title: CARA: Causally Guided Retrieval Agent for Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2610.22017v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation over text-rich knowledge graphs requires identifying evidence that contributes to answering a question, rather than merely matching its textual content. Existing agentic retrievers adaptively balance global search and multi-hop exploration but primarily rely on textual similarity to guide retrieval. We propose CARA, a training-free, CAusally guided Retrieval Agent that explicitly evaluates the causal relevance of retrieved evidence through two complementary criteria: consequentiality, measuring whether adding evidence improves answerability, and essentiality, assessing whether removing evidence weakens answerability. CARA integrates these assessments with path consistency to guide graph exploration and employs reciprocal rank fusion to aggregate evidence from multiple agents. translated_title: CARA：因果引导的问答检索智能体
translated_abstract: 在文本丰富的知识图谱上进行检索增强生成，需要识别对回答问题有贡献的证据，而不仅仅是匹配其文本内容。现有的智能体检索器虽然能够自适应地平衡全局搜索与多跳探索，但主要依赖文本相似性来引导检索。我们提出了CARA，一个无需训练的、因果引导的检索智能体，它通过两个互补的准则显式评估所检索证据的因果相关性：后果性，衡量添加证据是否能提高问题的可回答性；本质性，评估移除证据是否会削弱问题的可回答性。CARA将这些评估与路径一致性相结合以引导图谱探索，并采用倒数排名融合来聚合来自多个智能体的证据。我们在三个STaRK数据集上评估了CARA，并利用真实答案对STaRK进行了扩充，以支持下游问答任务的评估。
tldr: CARA是一个无需训练的因果引导检索智能体，通过后果性和本质性两个因果准则评估证据相关性并结合路径一致性引导知识图谱探索，克服了现有方法仅依赖文本相似性的局限。
en_tdlr: CARA is a training-free causally guided retrieval agent that evaluates evidence relevance via causal criteria of consequentiality and essentiality, combined with path consistency for knowledge graph exploration, overcoming the limitation of existing methods that rely solely on textual similarity.
